language.string: A military camp to help train and improve your army and doctrine.
A fortified Citadel mill that generates resources and supports nearby Settlers. Food, Wood, and Coin branch upgrades unlock matching local gathering auras.
A large cultivated olive orchard. Villagers gather Wood from its mature trees.
A fortified caravan station that arranges special economic and military shipments unlocked through City Planning.
Archaic ranged infantry effective against heavy infantry and light cavalry.
Heavy hand infantry effective against cavalry and light infantry.
Professional heavy ranged infantry effective against cavalry and light infantry.
Mobile mounted ranged infantry that can dismount to fight on foot.
Dismounted ranged infantry effective against heavy infantry and light cavalry.
Deploys into the appropriate population-supporting residence for your civilization.
A defensive hunting post that automatically gathers Food from nearby huntable animals.
A fortified administrative headquarters that manages city planning, civic programs, and frontier development.
Manages persistent colony policies such as War Economy, Trade Charter, and Civil Defense.
The governor's headquarters, where foreign advisers, merchants, and military missions can be received.
Invite foreign advisers, merchants, and military specialists to the Government House. Requires 100 Diplomatic Reputation. Only one Foreign Mission may be hosted at a time.

British advisers increase villager and land-military hit points by 7%; Musketeer hit points and damage by 15% and range by 3; and Hussar hit points and damage by 15%. Unlocks British units and research at the Government House.

Ends the British Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.
French advisers improve villager work rates by 5%; Rifleman hit points and damage by 25%; and Rifleman range by 3. Unlocks French units and research at the Government House.

Ends the French Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.
Spanish advisers generate 0.8 experience per second and improve villager mining work rates. Unlocks Spanish units and research at the Government House.

Ends the Spanish Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.

Portuguese engineers reduce building Wood costs by 15%; increase Musketeer and gunpowder-cavalry hit points and damage by 15%; and grant Musketeers 15% hand resistance. Unlocks Portuguese units and research at the Government House.

Ends the Portuguese Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.
Dutch financiers generate 0.8 Coin per second, increase Halberdier hit points and damage by 35%, and improve Bank productivity by 15%. Unlocks Dutch units and research at the Government House.

Ends the Dutch Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.

German quartermasters generate 0.4 Food, Wood, and Coin per second; reduce cavalry-infantry Food costs by 10%; and increase Rifleman hit points and damage by 25% with 15% ranged resistance. Unlocks German units and research at the Government House.

Ends the German Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.

Russian organizers reduce land economic-unit Food costs and training time by 10%, and reduce land-military Food, Wood, and Coin costs and training time by 20%. Unlocks Russian units and research at the Government House.

Ends the Russian Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.

Ottoman surveyors increase economic-unit, military-unit, and building line of sight by 7. Ottoman artillery gains 35% hit points but moves 15% slower. Unlocks Ottoman units and research at the Government House.

Ends the Ottoman Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.
Italian architects reduce building Wood costs by 20% and improve Lombard Food and Wood investment yields by 50%. Unlocks Italian units and research at the Government House.

Ends the Italian Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.
Swedish officers increase the hit points of villagers and land military units by 7%. Unlocks Caroleans, Finnish Riders, Leather Cannons, and Swedish research at the Government House.

Ends the Swedish Mission and removes its benefits and unit roster. Reputation loss: 100 before 3 minutes, 75 before 5 minutes, 50 before 10 minutes, 25 before 15 minutes, and none thereafter. Another mission requires 100 reputation.
Improves Rangers and other gunpowder troops.
Reduces unit training time and increases unit hit points by 10%.
Delivers two Factory Wagons to establish powerful resource or heavy-artillery production.
Strengthens settlers and delivers experienced British immigrant workers.
Delivers French fusiliers and improves the attack speed of gunpowder troops.
Improves cavalry armor, hit points, and damage and provides elite French cavalry.
Strengthens Coureurs and provides experienced French immigrant workers.
Provides treasure wagons and improves villager Coin gathering.
Strengthens the Explorer, provides Conquistadors, and improves their effectiveness against artillery.
Improves archaic and hand infantry and reduces the population cost of mercenaries.
Provides New Spain reinforcements and associated colonial improvements.
Establishes Portuguese trading infrastructure and its economic benefits.
Improves the range and effectiveness of Portuguese artillery.
Improves the attack and hit points of Dragoons and related mounted gunpowder units.
Improves Dutch military organization and unit performance.
Provides a Holy Roman mercenary army and improves mercenary combat strength.
Improves German settlers and the population capacity of German houses.
Improves the attack, hit points, and armor of hand infantry.
Unlocks and improves German Chevau-léger cavalry.
Reorganizes Russian infantry and improves their battlefield performance.
Improves Musketeer attack and hit points and enables defensive construction under the required conditions.
Grants area damage to hand cavalry.
Provides Ottoman artillery reinforcements and reduces their population cost.
Adds improved Janissaries to the standing infantry force.
Strengthens the Ottoman Explorer, increases movement speed, and provides an additional Explorer.
Provides and improves the Ottoman household corps.
Provides Lombard Wagons and invests Coin to generate Food and Wood over time.
Improves Italian infantry through Roman tactical doctrine.
Improves Lombard investment returns and resource-conversion speed.
Improves trade income and commercial infrastructure.
Improves Swedish mining and ironworking production.
Improves Swedish forestry and Wood production.
Improves hand cavalry hit points and attack speed.
Changes Musketeer resistance to ranged damage and increases Grenadier hit points.

Versatile ranged infantry and economic unit. Gathers Food and Wood, collects resource crates and treasures, regenerates while idle, performs Carbine and Eagle Eye attacks, and earns bonuses through Hunting Promotions.
Ranged villager limited to five units.
Cree Coureur des Bois. Strong ranged villager with superior gathering rates and resistance to ranged attacks.
Adventurers League vanguard. Durable hand infantry equipped to hold the front line.
Adventurers League frontline fighter specializing in powerful melee attacks.
Adventurers League ranger and support party member with exceptional attack range.
Adventurers League mage and support party member. Hurls explosive fireballs at enemies and buildings, but is extremely vulnerable in close combat.
A covered wagon that transports up to 12 infantry, villagers, or Guild members. It cannot construct a Town Center.
Transports up to 12 infantry, villagers, or Guild members.
Specialize your army around infantry warfare.
Specialize your army around cavalry warfare.
Specialize your army around artillery warfare.
Unlocks Crossbowmen and Boneguard. Archaic Infantry train 10% faster.
Unlocks Conscripts and Volunteers. Infantry train 15% faster and cost 10% less.
Unlocks Line Infantry and Professional Officer Corps. Infantry training XP reward increased by 15%.
Ranged Infantry gain +4 Hand Attack. Hand Infantry gain +8 Hand Attack.
Musketeer-type infantry gain +1.0 ranged damage multiplier against cavalry. Ranged infantry gain +2 range.
Hand Infantry move 1.0 faster and gain +1.0 damage multiplier against Light Infantry.
Musket Infantry greatly increase combat prowess when in Stand Ground stance.
Infantry line of sight increased by 4. Infantry XP bounty increased by 10%.
Infantry movement speed increased by 10% and melee attacks apply stronger snare.
Boneguards periodically unleash a sweeping melee attack that damages nearby enemies. Recharges every 20 seconds.
Commit to a compact, fortified city. Unlocks Citadel City Planning improvements and permanently prevents Sprawling City Planning.

Commit to a broad, fast-growing settlement. Buildings are constructed 25% faster, but have 10% fewer hitpoints. Unlocks Sprawling City Planning improvements and permanently prevents Citadel City Planning.
Increases the Settler limit by 3, Unlock Coureur Cree, and +10% Settler Damage.
Increases the Settler limit by 4 and the Coureur Cree limit by 3.
Increases the Settler limit by 5 and the Coureur Cree limit by 3.
Increases Settler capacity, building health, civilian ranged resistance, and artificial-resource gather speed.
Bunker Mills generate an additional 0.25 Coin per second and gain +1 build limit. Unlocks the Citadel Stockpile shipment and the Treasury Exchange technology.
Markets become housing for travelers providing protection and services +5 population
Your colony being the only safe place secure and safe trade you reap the rewards.Markets gain 10% better purchase and sale rates and +500 hitpoints
Trade Posts cost 10% less Wood. Unlocks the Native Scouts shipment at the Colonial Secretariat.

Native warriors move 15% faster, attack 25% faster, train 10% faster, and have 125% higher build limits. Mercenary Cree Trackers gain the upgrades from 1st Michigan Volunteer Sharpshooters: +60% base hit points and damage, Eagle Eye, and +9 line of sight.
The settlement must survive. Each settler when defeated comes back as a filibuster
Enables Filibuster training at The Presidio. Filibusters and Peltrymen gain +35% damage, +35% hit points, deal 3x damage against pets and treasure guardians, and gain +0.25 damage against heroes.
Increases the shared Settler build limit by 2 and delivers a House Wagon that can construct your civilization's available housing.
Increases the shared Settler build limit by 3, delivers a House Wagon, and attracts 3 citizens drawn from the common and uncommon settler tiers.
Increases the shared Settler build limit by 10, delivers a House Wagon, and attracts 3 citizens drawn from the common and uncommon settler tiers.
Increases the shared Settler build limit by 15, delivers a House Wagon, and attracts 3 citizens with all settler tiers available.
Increases the shared Settler build limit by 15, delivers a House Wagon, attracts 3 citizens with all settler tiers available, and unlocks Request Colonial Migrants at the Colonial Secretariat.
Increases the shared Settler build limit by 25, delivers a House Wagon, and attracts 3 citizens with all settler tiers available.
Increases the build limit of Houses by 5.
Increases the build limit of Houses by 5.
Increases the build limit of Houses by 5. Ships 1 Homestead Wagon and 1 Military Wagon. Both wagons can also be trained at The Presidio.
Increases the build limit of Houses by 5.
Increases the build limit of Houses by 5. Each House automatically generates 0.10 Coin per second.
Settlers gather Food 5% faster from huntable animals and berry bushes. Huntables, Trees, and Mines yield 10% more resources. Hunting Lodges cost 15% less Wood.
Hunting Lodges increase nearby Settlers' natural Food gathering rate by 10%. Hunting Lodges harvest nearby huntable animals 12.5% faster.
Hunting Lodges and Settlers gain +5 ranged attack.
Huntables, Trees, and Mines yield 10% more resources.
Unlocks the repeatable Buffalo Herds shipment at the Caravanserai.
Villagers gather Food from all farm-type buildings 15% faster, and herdable animals fatten 10% faster.
Villagers gain 30% Food gather rate at all farm-type buildings, and herdable animals fatten 20% faster. Combined with Plows and Pastures: +45% farm gathering and +30% fattening.
Increases the build limit of all herdable animal types by 15%.
Farm-type buildings provide +5 population, cost 10% less Wood, and construct 10% faster. The population bonus adds to existing housing effects.
Unlocks repeatable Food-to-Wood and Food-to-Coin exchanges on the second row of the Caravanserai.
Unlocks repeatable Food, Wood, and Coin shipment requests at the Colonial Secretariat.
Grants 1 shipment point, generates 0.25 XP per second, and allows the Caravanserai to be selected as the arrival point for economic or military Home City shipments.
Improves Market and Livestock Market exchange rates by 5%.
Unlocks the Trade Shipments policy at the Colonial Secretariat.
Improves Market and Livestock Market exchange rates by 10% and increases goods received whenever a trader reaches your Trading Posts by 10%.
Increases goods received whenever a trader reaches your Trading Posts by 50%.
Settlers and villagers gain +5 line of sight and +0.25 damage multiplier against treasure guardians.
Settlers and villagers gather Wood from trees and Groves 15% faster.
Increases the Outpost build limit by 7. Outposts and Forts gain veterancy from defeating enemy units.
Increases the Fort build limit by 2.
Economic and construction wagons move 15% faster and construct buildings 20% faster.
Generates 0.75 Food, Wood, and Coin per second through permanent overland commerce.
Buildings cost 10% fewer resources but have 10% fewer hit points.
Buildings cost an additional 15% fewer resources but have an additional 10% fewer hit points.
Mercenaries cost 10% fewer resources and train 10% faster.
Mercenaries gain 10% hit points and damage.
Coin gathering from Plantations and civilization-specific Coin farms is increased by 25%. Unlocks repeatable Coin-to-Wood and Coin-to-Food exchanges on the second row of the Caravanserai.
Outposts cost 10% less Wood and build 15% faster. Settlers gain +1 line of sight. Unlocks Peltrymen at The Presidio with a build limit of 5.
Unlocks the Call in the Reserve shipment at the Colonial Secretariat.
Unlocks Frontier Forts, Fort Towers, and Fixed Guns for Architects, strengthens defensive structures, and unlocks the State of Siege policy at the Colonial Secretariat.

Enacts the Prosperity Charter: villagers gather 15% faster and build 25% faster, while unfinished buildings auto-build 25% faster. Military buildings work 25% slower, while land military has 15% less damage and health.

Enacts a War Economy: supports 75 additional population, land military moves 10% faster, military buildings work 20% faster, and land military deals 5% more damage. Villagers gather 15% slower and have 10% less health.
Enacts the Development Charter: Economic Buildings work 20% faster for research and advancement. Military Buildings work 20% slower and land military moves 10% slower.

Enacts Trade Shipments: The Colonial Secretariat generates 1.25 XP per second, future Trade Route income is increased by 25%, and Market exchange rates are 10% more favorable. Villagers gather resources 10% slower, and land military units take 33% longer to train.
State of Siege policy is active.
Invest 1,500 Food, 1,500 Wood, and 1,500 Coin to restore 25 Diplomatic Reputation. Foreign Missions may only be selected at 100 reputation.
Hidden marker used to track Foreign Mission duration and diplomatic reputation.
Choose a Foreign Mission to Host
Choose a foreign nation whose mission will be hosted at the Government House.
A residence within an independent city-state.
Provides population space while the city-state is under your control.
A residence within a local village.
Provides population space while the village is under your control.
Spends two Home City shipments to send food crates to your gather point. Arrives in 120 seconds.
Spends two Home City shipments to send wood crates to your gather point. Arrives in 120 seconds.
Spends two Home City shipments to send coin crates to your gather point. Arrives in 120 seconds.
Slowly musters Papal Guards, Papal Zouaves, and Schiavones while the city-state is under your control.
Allows this Papal Embassy to train Priests, Missionaries, and Inquisitors.
Spends two Home City shipments and 500 Food to send three randomly selected workers, with a chance to receive uncommon or rare specialists. Arrives in 120 seconds.
Spends two Home City shipments to call five Mercenary Cree Trackers to your gather point. Arrives in 45 seconds.
Spends two Home City shipments and 200 Food to call twelve Conscripts to your gather point. Arrives in 30 seconds.
Spends two Home City shipments to send 100 Food, 100 Wood, and 100 Coin to your gather point. Arrives in 120 seconds.
Spends two Home City shipments to send three Bison for every Hunting Lodge you currently own to your shipment gather point. Arrives in 120 seconds.
Send three Bison per Hunting Lodge.
Spends one Home City shipment. After 30 seconds, exchanges your entire Food stockpile at a rate of 1 Food for 0.75 Wood.
Spends one Home City shipment. After 30 seconds, exchanges your entire Food stockpile at a rate of 1 Food for 0.70 Coin.
Spends one Home City shipment. After 30 seconds, exchanges your entire Coin stockpile at a rate of 1 Coin for 1.25 Wood.
Spends one Home City shipment. After 30 seconds, exchanges your entire Coin stockpile at a rate of 1 Coin for 1.10 Food.
A gathering place for adventurers and treasure hunters. Guild services are not yet available.
Future home of adventurers and treasure-hunting expeditions.
Choose the Adventurers League. Unlocks a balanced hero party and general adventurer hirelings. Permanently excludes the other Guild paths.
Choose the Black Company. Unlocks a hero party and hirelings focused on assassins, bounty hunters, and covert specialists. Permanently excludes the other Guild paths.
Choose the Hunters Guild. Unlocks a hero party and hirelings drawn from hunters, trackers, pathfinders, couriers, and wilderness allies. Permanently excludes the other Guild paths.
Choose the Order of the Silverband. Unlocks an exclusive hero party specialized in hunting legendary creatures. Permanently excludes the other Guild paths.

Organize an expedition and unlock the Expedition Wagon. Wagons gain +4 line of sight, party members gain +2 line of sight, and Guild adventurers train 10% faster. New party members also take 5 seconds longer to prepare.
Commission trained surveyors. Guild adventurers gain +6 line of sight, +10% hit points, and +10% damage. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.
Equip the main party for dangerous encounters. Party members gain +10% hit points and deal 1.25x damage against treasure guardians and pets. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.

Guild Party Members gain +15 hit points and +5% speed. Expedition Wagons heal nearby Guild adventurers for 2 hit points per second and garrisoned units for 3 hit points per second. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.
Enemies defeated near Guild Party Members grant +25% experience. This effect does not stack. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.
Defeated Guardians grant additional Gold equal to 25% of their normal experience bounty. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.
Guild Party Members gain +15% hit points and an additional +0.25 damage multiplier against Guardians and Pets. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.
Each living Guild Party Member generates 0.15 XP per second and gains +5% damage. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.

Guild Party Members gain the hero-style passive health regeneration ability and become incapacitated instead of dying, allowing them to recover and return to the expedition. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.

The main party becomes true Heroes and gains the golden heroic presence, +25% base hit points and damage, and 20% faster primary and secondary charged-ability recharge. New party members take 5 seconds longer to train.
Unlocks Shielder's Block passive, granting a 10% chance to completely block an incoming attack, and increases Shielder's melee armor by 5 percentage points.

Unlocks I Am Your Shield and Challenge. Nearby allied military units take 10% less damage. Shielder regenerates 1 hit point per second, even in combat, and gains +5% damage per nearby allied military unit, up to +25%.
Increases Challenge's melee and ranged armor-bonus duration from 10 to 20 seconds. Shielder also gains +15% damage and +50 hit points.

Unlocks Shield Bash and Heavy Strike. Shield Bash deals 25 Hand damage and stuns its target for 3 seconds every 12 seconds. Heavy Strike deals 75 Hand damage with +25% damage against Guardians, Pets, and Infantry every 14 seconds.
Shielder technology. Effects to be determined.
Shielder technology. Effects to be determined.
Shielder technology. Effects to be determined.

Core Passive: Nearby allied military units within 24 range take 10% less damage. Shielder constantly regenerates 1 hit point per second and gains +5% damage per nearby allied military unit, up to +25%.
Strike a nearby enemy for 25 Hand damage and damage all enemies within an area of 18, provoking their retaliation. Shielder gains +10% melee and ranged armor for 20 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
Charged Attack: Deals 25 Hand damage and stuns the target for 3 seconds. Recharges every 12 seconds.
A shield strike that briefly stuns one enemy.
Charged Attack: Deals 75 Hand damage with +25% damage against Guardians, Pets, and Infantry. Recharges every 14 seconds.
A powerful sword strike especially effective against Guardians, Pets, and Infantry.
Every 30 seconds, the Caster hurls a greater fireball that deals 100 Siege damage to all enemies within an area of 3.
This Party Member projects a Heroic Aura. Its effects are expanded and improved through Guild technologies.
This Party Member earns permanent combat promotions by defeating enemies. Each rank increases maximum hit points and damage, while every second rank also improves attack and movement speed.
Strike a nearby enemy for 25 Hand damage and damage all enemies within an area of 18, provoking their retaliation. Shielder gains +10% melee and ranged armor for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
Challenge: Shielder has +10% melee and ranged armor.
Shielder has a 10% chance to completely block an incoming attack.
Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank.
Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Line of sight +2.
Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Hit points +10%; damage +10%; line of sight +8.

Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Hit points +20%; damage +10%; line of sight +8; Guardian and Pet damage multiplier +0.25.

Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Hit points +20% and +15; damage +10%; line of sight +8; movement speed +5%; Guardian and Pet damage multiplier +0.25.

Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Hit points +20% and +15; damage +10%; line of sight +8; movement speed +5%; Guardian and Pet damage multiplier +0.25; enemy experience bounty +25% within 26 range (does not stack).

Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Hit points +35% and +15; damage +10%; line of sight +8; movement speed +5%; Guardian and Pet damage multiplier +0.50; enemy experience bounty +25% within 26 range (does not stack).

Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Hit points +35% and +15; damage +15%; line of sight +8; movement speed +5%; Guardian and Pet damage multiplier +0.50; enemy experience bounty +25% within 26 range (does not stack); experience generation +0.15 per second.

Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Hit points +35% and +15; damage +15%; line of sight +8; movement speed +5%; Guardian and Pet damage multiplier +0.50; enemy experience bounty +25% within 26 range (does not stack); experience generation +0.15 per second; regeneration +0.25 hit points per second while idle; becomes incapacitated instead of dying.

Combat Promotion: Hit points and damage +2% per rank; attack and movement speed +1% every second rank. Upgrade totals: Hit points +60% and +15; damage +40%; line of sight +8; movement speed +5%; Guardian and Pet damage multiplier +0.50; enemy experience bounty +25% within 26 range (does not stack); experience generation +0.15 per second; regeneration +0.25 hit points per second while idle; becomes incapacitated instead of dying; charged-ability cooldown -20%; gains the golden heroic effect.
Block: 10% chance to completely block an incoming attack. Melee armor: +5 percentage points.

Block: 10% chance to completely block an incoming attack. Melee armor: +5 percentage points. Nearby allied military units within 24 range take 10% less damage. Regeneration: +1 hit point per second. Damage: +5% per nearby ally, up to +25%.

Block: 10% chance to completely block an incoming attack. Melee armor: +5 percentage points. Nearby allied military units within 24 range take 10% less damage. Regeneration: +1 hit point per second. Damage: +5% per nearby ally, up to +25%. Hit points: +50. Additional damage: +15%.
